items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: I heard of King Foley. King Foley, yeah, I heard of him.

ctx.x: Did you know King Foley? He was the king of the town. Do you remember him?
I heard of King Foley. King Foley, yeah, I heard of him. Name for me is him.
Is there anything more you were going to tell about Jelly Roll? When did he leave here? Did he stay around long, do you remember? He didn't stay here, I don't think.
